Wormskin is armour-like rather than a trigger-based bonus: it applies whenever you're unarmored, with its own Dex cap of +3 and rune slots. This bonus/penalty exists only inside the Whirling Throw action itself (it is not a general Athletics modifier). Do you want action-internal size modifiers starred on the Athletics skill, or is that display noise you would rather keep out of the registry?

One free action randomly picks ONE of four mutually exclusive benefits (1d4). Six stars would light up at once even though at most one applies on any given use. Do you want all six markers, or a single grouped marker on one representative stat with the 1d4 table in the popup?

This is a fortune reroll, not a typed bonus, and the affected skills vary by which bravado actions the character actually has (Tumble Through = Acrobatics, Demoralize = Intimidation, Feint = Deception, Bon Mot = Diplomacy, ...). Should it be one skill:'all' marker, or should it be expanded per bravado action the character owns?
Fold the +5-foot leg into the computed Speed and star only the panache upgrade, or leave both legs as situational markers?

The feat itself grants no new bonus — it only compresses the actions needed to reach the clan dagger's own parry bonus ('the +1 circumstance bonus to your AC FROM your clan dagger's parrying trait'). Should the star be registered on this feat, or on the clan dagger item once the item lane can show markers? Registering it in both places would double-star AC.

This is really a temporary +1 potency rune on ONE chosen item, and the app already models potency runes. Should Battleforger be a star, or should it instead be offered as a temporary rune the player applies to a specific item (which would make the numbers real)? As a star it is imprecise — it cannot say WHICH weapon, and it must not appear if every weapon already has a potency rune.

Does the app want granted-to-another-creature bonuses in this registry at all, and can a character use Prepare Elemental Medicine on themselves (the text says 'a creature' and never forbids self, but consistently says 'your patient')?

HH's exclusive-stance manager (content.stances / Character.activeStance) already injects a stance's speed change into the derived numbers while the stance is toggled on. Should stance feats also appear as situational stars, or would that double-report the same bonus?

Which stat does HH use for a vehicle 'piloting check'? PF2e resolves it with whatever skill the vehicle lists (commonly Piloting Lore, Nature, or Sailing Lore), so there is no single skill key to flag - should this be skill 'all', a lore key, or skipped until vehicles carry a piloting-skill field?

Only Repair is a defined skill action (Crafting). Load, Aim and move a siege weapon are crew actions with no fixed skill in HH - should the star flag Crafting alone, or should there be a stat-less 'siege weapon crew checks' note?

Hydraulic Maneuvers grants NO bonus — it suppresses item bonuses and body-related circumstance bonuses and upgrades a critical failure to a failure. Should the situational registry carry non-bonus modifiers like this (a star that warns rather than promises), or should it hold only actual bonuses and leave suppressions out?

For the Mythic-Point version, does the speaking character count as one of "every individual within a 10-mile radius" and so get the +2 status bonus to Earn Income themselves? If yes, this should also carry a skill/'all' entry limited to Earn Income checks.

Should healing you deliver to OTHERS (Battle Medicine / Treat Wounds targets) be surfaced on your own sheet at all — e.g. as a reminder chip on the Medicine skill rather than a star on your HP?

Downtime-earned, expiring, campaign-state bonuses like this one: registry star, Modes toggle, or leave out entirely?
